messages:
Kai (Docs): heads-up: nightly linkcheck flagged a broken fragment: /tutorials/quickstart -> #using-python-sdk
CI-Bot: LINKCHECK: Broken fragment -> /tutorials/quickstart#using-python-sdk (404)
Kai (Docs): that anchor used to work. i grabbed the MD for the page and the heading currently is: 
```
## Using `python` SDK
```
Zoe (Tech Writer): aha. inline code in headings got normalized differently after we upgraded the markdown parser. some slugifiers turn the backticks into nothing, others keep the word and drop punctuation. old slug was #using-python-sdk, new one is #using-python-sdk-1 or sometimes #using-python-sdk-python depending on slug rules
Megan (Eng): reproducible locally: docusaurus v3 + remark plugin collapses inline code to 'python' but adds extra token sometimes. customer links and our own quickstart note point at #using-python-sdk, hence linkcheck failing
Rory (DevEx): plan: short-term add explicit id to the heading so anchors are stable; mid-term add a small canonicalization step to linkcheck CI to accept known redirect pairs; also add a short migration note in docs/contrib/slug-stability.md explaining inline-code caveats
Megan (Eng): I'll open a tiny PR that: 1) adds an explicit id, 2) updates internal references to the explicit id, 3) adds a redirect rule in the docusaurus redirects plugin. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4981
Megan (Eng): heading patch to push: 
```md
## Using `python` SDK {#using-python-sdk}
```
Megan (Eng): redirect config snippet (docusaurus plugin): 
```js
['@docusaurus/plugin-client-redirects', {
  redirects: [
    { to: '/tutorials/quickstart#using-python-sdk', from: ['/tutorials/quickstart#using-python-sdk-1'] }
  ]
}]
```
Kai (Docs): nice. can we also search for other headings with inline code (backticks) and add explicit ids only where they are externally linked? less churn that way
Zoe (Tech Writer): i'll grep the repo for headings containing '`' and open docs PRs for any public-facing pages. found 6 candidates in guides and tutorials so far
Rory (DevEx): i'll modify linkcheck to load redirects and treat matching redirects as ok for now; also add a warning log when canonicalized slug != original, so we can triage later
CI-Bot: PR 4981 | checks started
Megan (Eng): added a short migration note to docs/migration/slugifier-changes.md explaining the inline code gotchas and recommending explicit ids for customer-facing anchors
Kai (Docs): once CI passes, merge and deploy. schedule a small audit next week for the top 50 inbound fragment hits to proactively add ids where needed
Zoe (Tech Writer): i'll open PRs for the other 6 pages after this merges. will tag people on pages I own
Rory (DevEx): follow-ups: 1) merge PR 4981, 2) deploy site, 3) run anchor audit, 4) roll back linkcheck warning to fail-only after 2 weeks if no further churn
Kai (Docs): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
